data.narrative:
Until, a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, has raised $106M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. Using total raised ($106M) as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a standard 2.0x multiplier for Series A to next-stage advancement yields $212M. The Peer-Median approach was not feasible due to insufficient narrow-filter comparables—while 7 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of three or more datapoints when filtered by stage, timing, and valuation tier. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be executed because Until's revenue is not disclosed; the public biotech median trades at 9.2x P/S, but without target revenue this multiple cannot be applied.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $180M to $244M, centered at $212M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include Until's undisclosed revenue trajectory, the limited availability of truly comparable private biotech Series A datasets, and public market multiples' diminishing relevance to early-stage private valuations. A revenue-based approach or additional private comparables would meaningfully tighten this range.
